invariants: Provider participation does not confer governance authority.
Provider-neutral contracts belong in schemas rather than a provider repository.
Multi-entity collaboration belongs in sandbox rather than a provider repository.
StegVerse_AI remains distinct from provider identities, Ecosystem_Chat, and governance authority.
Ecosystem_Chat is an SV-LLM ecosystem entity and interface contract owner; its current public/browser implementation remains in StegVerse-Labs/Site.

Existing StegVerse Task Registry, WorkerCoordinator, Interlock/InTr, LLM-adapter, TV/TVC, Publisher and SDK authorities, and Master Records organization records and reconstruction, are not duplicated in SV-LLM.

completeness_assessment.organizational_decomposition: The currently enumerated repositories cover organization coordination, shared schemas, provider-neutral collaboration, StegVerse_AI ecosystem intelligence, Ecosystem_Chat external-ecosystem interaction, and eighteen provider capability surfaces.
completeness_assessment.implementation_state: Repository existence does not establish implementation or integration completeness. Empty/uninitialized repositories require their role contracts and implementations to be established before runtime completeness can be claimed.
